submissions.title: OrmUtils.normalizeWhereCriteria() does not implement described default behaviour for invalidWhereValuesBehavior
submissions.proposalText: Verified the bug: OrmUtils.normalizeWhereCriteria() returns criteria unchanged when no options object is passed, so the documented default ("throw" on undefined) never fires — UPDATE/DELETE queries silently run with undefined-as-null WHERE clauses instead of raising a TypeORMError. I'd fix this by giving the options parameter a default of { null: "ignore", undefined: "throw" } to match the documented default-1 behavior, add a regression test asserting the throw when undefined is passed with no explicit invalidWhereValuesBehavior, and verify no existing tests relied on the silent-pass behavior. I can have a PR up within a few days — happy to start now if this is still open.
